description: Proceeded to confirmation and clicked 'Confirm Reservation' for a 6:15 PM tee time without verifying it matched the preferred window. The confirmation screen explicitly displayed '6:15 PM' before checkbox and confirmation button. I should have caught this discrepancy and gone back to reselect before confirming.
correction: When the confirmation screen appeared showing 6:15 PM, I should have recognized this was outside the preferred 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM window and found a way to edit/cancel and reselect 4:45 PM before confirming the reservation.
systemic_fix: Golf-booking skill Step 4g: Before clicking Confirm Reservation, explicitly verify the displayed time is within the preferred window for the selected option. If not, abort confirmation and go back to Step 4 to try the next ranked option.
